      "name": "mempool",

      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/mempool_accept.py only to update test expectations for deserialization errors.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Does not alter mempool acceptance logic, policy rules, or mempool data structures. The test update merely accommodates earlier stream deserialization failures for invalid transactions."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Alters src/net_processing.cpp and blockencodings to handle transaction and block deserialization rejections over P2P streams.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Protects nodes against peer-driven memory exhaustion by rejecting invalid transactions during P2P stream deserialization. A malicious peer could previously 'send a 4 MB block containing roughly 400,000 empty transactions (10 bytes each) that each allocate a full CTransaction object'."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes transaction serialization infrastructure in src/primitives/transaction.h and serializer parameters.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.58,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Hardens serialization primitives against excessive memory allocations. Bounding vin and vout vectors during deserialization allows immediate bounded allocations (to 2.7 MB for inputs and 5.3 MB for outputs) rather than unbounded or repeated multi-megabyte reallocations."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch files in src/validation or change consensus validity rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Does not substantively alter validation code or consensus rules. The rejected transactions were already consensus-invalid; checking them during deserialization avoids passing them to validation altogether."
    }
  ],
